turns.q: I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?
turns.replyTail:
Before I can provide an order confirmation or discuss orders in detail, for security & privacy purposes, we do ask that you provide the following details;

Order Name
Order Email Address
Order Number
Item/s on the order

We appreciate your cooperation and understanding, as this step is crucial in information security and privacy protection.

Let me know if you have any questions. I am happy to help.

Kind regards,

turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Noah, once your order leaves our warehouse, you will automatically receive an email containing your tracking number and a link so you can follow its delivery in real time ✨

Orders are processed and dispatched on business days, excluding weekends and public holidays.

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Noah, once your order is dispatched, delivery times depend on the shipping method selected at checkout. For Australian orders, standard shipping takes 2 to 5 business days, and express shipping takes 1 to 3 business days. International delivery times vary by region.

Let me know if you need anything else.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
Noah, if tracking information remains static, please keep in mind that international shipments often do not update until the parcel reaches the destination country and clears customs.

If your order takes longer than the expected delivery timeframe to arrive, our support team can investigate the issue directly with our courier partner to resolve it for you as quickly as possible ❤️
